title: Sign in to Google Ad Manager - Google Ad Manager Help

facts.fact: Users whose Google account is linked to more than one Google Ad Manager account are prompted to choose which account to access when they sign in.
facts.quote: If your Google account is associated with more than one Google Ad Manager account, you'll be prompted to select the account you'd like to access when you sign in.

facts.fact: To switch between Google Ad Manager accounts after signing in, users click the account they are signed into in the top-left corner of Ad Manager and select another available account from the menu.
facts.quote: in the top-left corner of Ad Manager, click the account you're signed into and select another available account from the menu.

facts.fact: Google's help page says that users with a status of "Inactive" in an Ad Manager network cannot access the network until an administrator sets their status to "Active."
facts.quote: Inactive users can't access the network until an administrator sets their status to "Active."

facts.fact: Google's help page says that clearing browser cache may need to be repeated more than once if a sign-in issue persists.
facts.quote: You may need to clear your cache more than once if the issue persists.

facts.fact: Google's help page says that users with a "Pending invitation" status should check their inbox and spam folders for the invitation email and click the link in it to activate their user profile.
facts.quote: Check your inbox and spam folders for the invitation email, then click the link within that email to activate your user profile.

facts.fact: Google's help page says that using Ad Manager through a Google Workspace organization requires an administrator account to sign in to the Google Admin console, because non-administrator accounts cannot access the Admin console.
facts.quote: If you aren’t using an administrator account, you can’t access the Admin console.

facts.fact: Google's help page says that resending a user invitation requires the network administrator or a user with the "Edit users, roles, and teams" permission.
facts.quote: Your network administrator, or any user with the "Edit users, roles, and teams" permission, can resend the invitation.

facts.fact: Google's help page says that the Ad Manager service in the Google Admin console is enabled by switching Google Ad Manager to On.
